title: Mahi's No Pumpkin Blur
description: Removes the pumpkin overlay when wearing a carved pumpkin. Supports 1.6.1 – 26.2.
body:
# Mahi's No Pumpkin Blur

**Mahi's No Pumpkin Blur** removes the pumpkin overlay when wearing a carved pumpkin on your head!

## Features
- Removes the annoying pumpkin blur overlay completely
- Supports Java Edition 1.6.1 – 26.2

## Installation
Download the correct version for your Minecraft version from the files tab.
